summary.zh: 把 DSH 的私有协议翻译成手机客户端的双向帧与 REST 接口，并在设置页里提供配对、地址范围、外网隧道与设备管理；对话里发 /remote 就能开远程并取码，dsh-Go 里带一块只读的「接入」面板、输入区状态条和客户端下载二维码。
summary.en: Translates DSH's private protocol into bidirectional WebSocket frames and REST for mobile clients, with pairing, address scopes, tunnels and device management in the settings page; send /remote in chat to enable remote access and get a code, plus a read-only Access panel, status strip and client download QR codes in dsh-Go.
